segments.name: Wealth management
segments.description: Provides independent financial advisors and financial institutions with brokerage, advisory, custody, technology and practice management services.
segments.evidence: Management has determined that the Company operates in one segment, given the common nature of its operations, products and services, production and distribution process and regulatory environment.

revenueModel.text: Financial advisors and institutions pay LPL a share of advisory fees and brokerage commissions, plus separate fees for custody, trading, administrative and support services.
revenueModel.evidence: Advisors associated with Independent RIAs retain 100% of their advisory fees, and in return, we charge separate fees for custody, trading, administrative and support services.

changes.text: In 2025 the Company acquired Commonwealth Financial Network, whose broker-dealer assets are expected to be converted to the Company's platform in the fourth quarter of 2026.
changes.evidence: On August 1, 2025, the Company acquired 100% of the outstanding equity interests of Commonwealth Financial Network, a privately-held independent wealth management firm.

changes.text: In 2025 the Company completed the conversion of assets from the broker-dealers and investment advisers acquired with Atria and withdrew their registrations.
changes.evidence: The Company completed the conversion of assets from these acquired broker-dealers and investment advisers to the Company's platform and completed the withdrawal of the related registrations of these entities during the fourth quarter of 2025.
